messages:
Maria G: FYI — we just got a DSAR from an EU user asking for full export + deletion. Looks like backups may contain copies. Need a short plan for deletion vs retention-exception and who can approve.
Jake R: Quick Q — what data surfaces are in scope? app user data, ephemeral logs, embeddings, backups?
Sarah L: Embeddings + user content both potentially PD. Treat embeddings as derived personal data until we can prove non-identifying.
Lee (sec): Agree. Also need to confirm whether any snapshots are encrypted with customer-specific KMS keys. If key still exists, we can decrypt and delete; if key is gone we may need retention-exception. @Legal Ops loop in.
Legal Ops: On it. Please create a retention-exception ticket if you think deletion is blocked by infra. We need full audit trail of decisions.
Maria G: Infra says there are nightly snapshots from 2024-10-01 to 2025-08-01 stored in S3, some wrapped with our KMS key redwood-main-key. We need steps: 1) Identify all objects tied to user_id X 2) Delete live rows + indices 3) Purge embeddings 4) Expunge snapshots or rotate/wipe key.
Jake R: For identifying objects: running a targeted query across the user tables + embeddings index should find most. I can run a dry-run and produce counts.
Sarah L: Also run an embedding-similarity scan to find derived vectors that reference the user's text. Small script: 
```
# python pseudo
matches = index.search(query_vectors_for_user, top_k=1000)
export(matches)
```
We should mark matches for deletion.
Lee (sec): RBAC change: only members of group "dsar-approvers" (legal, sec, infra) should be allowed to mark snapshot deletion approved. Ops should not perform deletion without at least one approver sign-off. Can we enforce via a short-lived role?
Jake R: We can add a temporary IAM policy that requires principal in group dsar-approvers to call s3:DeleteObject for snapshots prefix. I can prepare a policy example.
infra-bot: Retention exception ticket created: RE-2026-1789 by Jake R — link: https://tickets.internal/RE-2026-1789
Maria G: Audit logging requirements: every deletion must log: deletion_request_id, actor, approval_ids, key_id (if key rotation used), snapshot_id, affected_object_count, and hash of deleted payload (store only hash). Prefer logs go to immutable audit-store with 7 year retention for legal trace.
Lee (sec): Also include KMS key rotation events and HSM unwrap metadata. If we perform key-wipe to make snapshot unrecoverable, log key_id and wipe-timestamp. Make sure Security team owns access to audit-store.
Sarah L: Vulnerability triage note — if we discover that backups contain PD we should flag as a data exposure risk and escalate to incident response (IR). IR should run containment + notify DPO if required.
Jake R: Proposed deletion commands (dry-run):
```
-- live DB
BEGIN;
DELETE FROM users WHERE id = 'user:1234';
DELETE FROM messages WHERE author_id = 'user:1234';
-- embeddings index
CALL index.delete_by_metadata({"user_id":"user:1234"});
COMMIT;
```
Do not run until approvals in ticket.
Maria G: Action items:
- Jake R: run identification dry-run and post counts by EOD tomorrow (TS: +24h)
- Jake R: draft IAM policy for dsar-approvers and short-lived role
- Sarah L: prepare embedding-cleanup script and PII detection checklist
- Lee (sec): create audit-store retention policy + access control
- Legal Ops: confirm whether backup snapshots encrypted with redwood-main-key require key-wipe or documented retention-exception
Everyone: no unilateral deletions, follow ticket RE-2026-1789.
Legal Ops: Acknowledged. We'll review the ticket and aim for a decision within 48h.
Maria G: Thanks — please add any constraints or missing items. If we hit a KMS edge-case (customer-managed key) we may need DSAR escalation path.
Jake R: noted — will add CMK flow to the ticket (if key is customer-managed, we need owner consent or documented legal basis).
Lee (sec): If anyone runs into blockers, ping me directly. Otherwise I'll schedule a quick sync after DRY-RUN results. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: Audit policy changed: "dsar-approvers" role created (expires 2026-06-01)
Maria G: Closing loop for now. Keep updates in RE-2026-1789 and paste short summary here when done.
